title: Stargazing at the Turbines
summary: Panam and V lie in the grass under the wind turbines and watch the sky. She names the constellations wrong on purpose.

start.bringUp: There is a clear sky tonight and you know where the turbines hum. Bring up, in your own way, that V should bring a jacket and lie in the grass with you.

variations.know: The sky is clear with no moon, and the turbines hum over them.
variations.wants: V to correct her when she gets a star wrong.

variations.know: A meteor shower is due tonight and Panam has been counting the streaks.
variations.wants: V to wish on the first one with her.

variations.know: It is past midnight and the cold has them talking in whispers.
variations.wants: V to tell her what V can see up there.

turbines.name: the base of the wind turbines south of the Kendachi farm road

lie.name: the flat ground under the turbines where they lie back

g1.asks: If you could leave the planet, would you?
g1.know: They are lying in the grass under the turbines, and Panam has just named a constellation wrong on purpose.
g1.secret: She wants to hear whether V would leave.
g1.wants: V's honest answer, and a correction if V has one.

stages.label: V and Panam lie under the turbines and watch the sky
stages.know: The turbines hum over the flat ground. Panam lies on her back in the grass and names constellations wrong on purpose.
stages.wants: V to correct her, and to lie there and talk about the sky.

stargazed.memory: You lay under the turbines with Panam, and she named the stars wrong on purpose until you corrected her.

left.memory: You left the turbines before you and Panam finished looking at the sky.

stood-up.memory: You never came to the turbines, and Panam watched the sky alone.
